value: Not stated. BC Hydro public planning document (2004 Integrated Electricity Plan); no copyright or reuse terms printed on the appendix.

BC Hydro (2004). 2004 Integrated Electricity Plan, Part 3 Resource Options, Appendix D: Alternative and Clean Energy - Other (Alternative and Clean (Other) Project Database). March 31, 2004. Project data from the BC Green Energy Study Phase 1 (2001) and Phase 2 (2002), Stothert Engineering, B.W. McCloy and Associates, Fairbank Engineering, EPRI Technical Assessment Guide (2002).

Region: British Columbia. Locators are the printed "Database Page: N of 304" numbers on each project sheet (the PDF holds 90 pages of the 304-page database appendix; PDF page numbers are not used). Per the power-dataset rule only heat-relevant options were taken: six biomass/MSW projects (landfill gas, MSW, woodwaste cogeneration), four geothermal projects and the three fuel cell options. Skipped: wind, wave, tidal, solar (16 + 4 + 2 + 4 sheets). Gas combined-cycle and gas turbine options are NOT in this appendix (they are in other appendices). Costs are "$1000s of 2003$" (CAD) and are PROJECT totals; they were converted to CAD/kW electric (capex, opex-fixed) by dividing by the installed capacity, with the arithmetic in formula and project totals in _other-values. None of the sheets prints a heat output: cogeneration sheets state "no revenue for steam sales"; heat figures exist only for fuel cells (PAFC overall efficiency 90% with 37% electrical; SOFC demonstration 65 kW thermal with 110 kW electric). Biomass fixed O&M includes fuel and wheeling cost (flagged in the notes). Fuel cell capital is for the generating MODULE ONLY (COST BASIS equipment) except one SOFC row for the total plant. Unit energy cost ($/MWh) is stored as cost-levelized with the printed uncertainty range. Geothermal plant sizes are illustrative (Fairbank). Greenhouse gas factor assumed zero for biomass and landfill gas (BC Hydro convention) and not stored.
